from manim import *
import numpy as np

class NeonAscension_Scene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        # [🛑 严禁修改区：赛博背景与安全排版引擎] ====================
        config.pixel_width, config.pixel_height = 1920, 1080
        config.frame_width, config.frame_height = 16, 9
        config.frame_rate, config.background_color = 60, "#0A0115" # 深邃紫黑
        C_NEON_PK, C_NEON_CY, C_W = "#FF00FF", "#00FFFF", "#FFFFFF"
        FONTS = ["Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Heiti SC", "sans-serif"]

        def get_safe_text(t_str, size, color, weight=NORMAL, max_w=5.5, ls=1.5):
            for f in FONTS:
                try:
                    t = Text(t_str, font=f, font_size=size, color=color, weight=weight, line_spacing=ls)
                    if t.width > 0.1: return t.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t.width > max_w else t
                except: continue
            t_fallback = Text(t_str, font_size=size, color=color, line_spacing=ls)
            return t_fallback.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t_fallback.width > max_w else t_fallback
        # [🛑 严禁修改区结束] =====================================

        # ==========================================
        # ⬇️ 变量替换区 
        # ==========================================
        MAIN_TITLE = "【<<<替换1：总标题>>>】"
        FINAL_SLOGAN = "【<<<替换2：结尾金句>>>】"

        # 格式：("楼层名称", "底层困局[带\n换行]", "升维密码[带\n换行]")
        ascension_data = [
            # 【<<<替换3：填入生成的数据，支持 3 到 5 组>>>】
            ("L1：出卖体力", "用时间换取微薄的死工资，\n一旦停下就没有收入。", "将技能产品化，一份时间卖出多次，\n构建属于自己的睡后收入。"),
            ("L2：出卖脑力", "陷入高级打工人的内卷，\n天天做PPT证明自己的价值。", "学会调动和分配资源，\n从执行者跃迁为系统的设计者。")
        ]
        # ==========================================

        # [🛑 严禁修改区：霓虹攀升与黄金分割列算法] ====================
        title_txt = get_safe_text(MAIN_TITLE, 80, C_NEON_CY, BOLD, max_w=12).move_to(UP*2)
        self.play(FadeIn(title_txt, shift=DOWN), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(title_txt.animate.scale(0.4).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5).set_opacity(0.6), run_time=0.8)

        num_floors = len(ascension_data)
        floor_spacing = 10.0 # Y轴极度拉开，制造强烈的向上攀升感
        
        # 中轴发光霓虹天梯
        elevator_shaft = Line([0, -2, 0], [0, num_floors * floor_spacing, 0], color=C_NEON_PK, stroke_width=2).set_opacity(0.5)
        self.play(Create(elevator_shaft), run_time=1)

        for i, (floor, trap, code) in enumerate(ascension_data):
            node_y = i * floor_spacing
            
            # 镜头向上攀升！
            self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.move_to([0, node_y, 0]), run_time=1.8, rate_func=smooth)
            
            # 楼层发光平台
            floor_line = DashedLine([-8, node_y-2.5, 0], [8, node_y-2.5, 0], color=C_NEON_CY, stroke_width=2)
            floor_txt = get_safe_text(floor, 40, C_NEON_PK, BOLD, max_w=6).move_to([0, node_y + 2.8, 0])
            self.play(Create(floor_line), Write(floor_txt), run_time=0.8)

            # 【核心排版：黄金分割双列锁】
            # 左侧文字死死锁定在 X = -4.25 (16宽度的 1/4 处)，最大宽度 5.5
            # 完美避开中心轴(0)和左边缘(-8.0)，视觉极度舒适且绝对安全！
            trap_title = get_safe_text("▼ 底层困局", 28, "#FF4B4B", BOLD)
            trap_desc = get_safe_text(trap, 26, LIGHT_GREY, max_w=5.5, ls=1.5)
            trap_grp = VGroup(trap_title, trap_desc).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
            trap_grp.move_to([-4.25, node_y, 0])
            
            # 右侧文字死死锁定在 X = 4.25 (16宽度的 3/4 处)，最大宽度 5.5
            code_title = get_safe_text("▲ 升维密码", 30, C_NEON_CY, BOLD)
            code_desc = get_safe_text(code, 28, C_W, max_w=5.5, ls=1.5)
            code_grp = VGroup(code_title, code_desc).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
            code_grp.move_to([4.25, node_y, 0])
            
            self.play(FadeIn(trap_grp, shift=RIGHT*0.5), FadeIn(code_grp, shift=LEFT*0.5), run_time=1.0)
            self.wait(2.5)
            
            # 暗化进入下一层
            self.play(VGroup(floor_txt, trap_grp, code_grp).animate.set_opacity(0.15), run_time=0.5)

        # 登顶仰望
        top_y = (num_floors - 1) * floor_spacing
        self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.move_to([0, top_y + 3, 0]), run_time=2.0)
        
        final_text = get_safe_text(FINAL_SLOGAN, 120, C_NEON_CY, BOLD, max_w=14).move_to([0, top_y + 3, 0])
        self.play(Write(final_text), Flash(final_text.get_center(), color=C_NEON_CY, flash_radius=8), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *

        self.play(

            run_time=0.15, rate_func=linear
        )

        self.add(title_main)

            self.play(scan_line.animate.scale(5).set_opacity(0), FadeIn(patch_grp, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=0.6)
            
            self.wait(3.0)
            self.play(FadeOut(mod_title), FadeOut(content), run_time=0.4)

        self.play(FadeOut(terminal), FadeOut(title_main), run_time=0.6)
        final_text = get_safe_text(FINAL_SLOGAN, 100, C_CYAN, BOLD, max_w=14)
        self.play(Write(final_text), Flash(final_text.get_center(), color=C_CYAN, flash_radius=8, num_lines=30), run_time=1.5)

                    if line.get_y() > -3.0: line.move_to([random.uniform(-7, 7), -4.5, 0])
            lava_stream.add_updater(update_lava)

            monolith = VGroup(mono_rect, corner_decor, content_grp, lava_stream).move_to(pos)
            monoliths_grp.add(monolith)
            self.add(monolith) # 预先添加到场景，营造档案馆感

        # 初始化摄像机在第一个碑
        self.camera.frame.move_to(monoliths_grp[0].get_center())

        for i, monolith in enumerate(monoliths_grp):
            # 镜头高速推进游历 (制造穿梭感)
            self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(monolith.get_center()).set_width(17), run_time=1.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_expo)
            
            flash = Flash(monolith.get_center(), color=C_CYAN, flash_radius=9, num_lines=40)
            self.play(flash, monolith.animate.set_opacity(1), run_time=0.5)
            
            self.wait(4.0) 
            
            # 镜头拉远准备前往下一个
            if i < len(monoliths_grp) - 1:
                self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.set_width(40), run_time=1.0, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_sine)

        # 最终镜头猛烈拉远，展现档案馆全貌
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(monoliths_grp.get_center()).set_width(monoliths_grp.width + 10),
            run_time=3.0, rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        final_text = get_safe_text(FINAL_SLOGAN, 120, C_GOLD, BOLD, max_w=monoliths_grp.width).next_to(monoliths_grp, DOWN, buff=2.0)
        self.play(Write(final_text), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(3)
        # [🛑 严禁修改区结束] =====================================

from manim import *
import numpy as np
import random

class DataWaterfall_Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # [🛑 严禁修改区：黑客背景与安全排版引擎] ====================
        config.pixel_width, config.pixel_height = 1920, 1080
        config.frame_width, config.frame_height = 16, 9
        config.frame_rate, config.background_color = 60, "#010103"
        FONTS = ["Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Heiti SC", "sans-serif"]
        C_CYAN, C_GREEN, C_W, C_RED = "#00FFCC", "#00FF87", "#FFFFFF", "#FF3333"

        def get_safe_text(t_str, size, color, weight=NORMAL, max_w=12.0, ls=1.6):
            for f in FONTS:
                try:
                    t = Text(t_str, font=f, font_size=size, color=color, weight=weight, line_spacing=ls)
                    if t.width > 0.1: return t.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t.width > max_w else t
                except: continue
            t_fallback = Text(t_str, font_size=size, color=color, line_spacing=ls)
            return t_fallback.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t_fallback.width > max_w else t_fallback
        # [🛑 严禁修改区结束] =====================================

        # ==========================================
        # ⬇️ 变量替换区 
        # ==========================================
        MAIN_TITLE = "【<<<替换1：总标题>>>】"
        FINAL_SLOGAN = "【<<<替换2：结尾金句>>>】"

        # 格式：("模块名称", "致命漏洞[带\n换行]", "硬核补丁[带\n换行]")
        matrix_data = [
            # 【<<<替换3：填入生成的数据，支持 3 到 5 组，支持长句排版>>>】
            ("System.bug() : 讨好型人格", "总是试图通过牺牲底线来获取别人的认可，\n在小心翼翼的试探中丧失了全部的主动权。", "人际交往的本质不是讨好，而是价值吸引。\n立刻执行冷酷切割，用实力去碾压，用价值去交换。"),
            ("System.bug() : 完美主义", "永远在等待100%完美的时机才肯出手，\n结果在无尽的筹备中错失了所有风口。", "完成大于完美。先开枪后瞄准，发射粗糙的MVP模型，\n在实战的炮火中获取数据，疯狂迭代你的系统。")
        ]
        # ==========================================

        # [🛑 严禁修改区：RGB故障震撼开场与数据瀑布排版引擎] ====================
        # 开头震撼效果：RGB故障色散
        warning = get_safe_text(">>> System Error. Rebooting Matrix...", 30, C_RED, BOLD).to_edge(UP, buff=4)
        self.play(AddTextLetterByLetter(warning), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.2)
        self.play(FadeOut(warning), run_time=0.1)

        # RGB 故障色散主标题聚拢
        title_r = get_safe_text(MAIN_TITLE, 130, RED, BOLD, max_w=14).shift(LEFT * 0.4 + UP * 0.2)
        title_g = get_safe_text(MAIN_TITLE, 130, GREEN, BOLD, max_w=14).shift(RIGHT * 0.3 + DOWN * 0.3)
        title_b = get_safe_text(MAIN_TITLE, 130, BLUE, BOLD, max_w=14).shift(RIGHT * 0.2 + UP * 0.4)
        title_main = get_safe_text(MAIN_TITLE, 130, C_W, BOLD, max_w=14)

        self.add(title_r, title_g, title_b)
        self.play(
            title_r.animate.move_to(ORIGIN), title_g.animate.move_to(ORIGIN), title_b.animate.move_to(ORIGIN),
            run_time=0.15, rate_func=linear
        )
        self.remove(title_r, title_g, title_b)
        self.add(title_main)
        # 解析光效
        self.play(Flash(ORIGIN, color=C_GREEN, flash_radius=6, num_lines=40), title_main.animate.scale(1.1), run_time=0.2)
        self.play(title_main.animate.scale(0.3).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5).set_color(C_CYAN), run_time=0.8)

        # 数据瀑布卡片 (强锁：宽13.0，高6.5)
        terminal = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, width=13.0, height=6.5, color=C_CYAN, stroke_width=2, fill_color="#0A1515", fill_opacity=0.6)
        terminal_glow = DashedVMobject(terminal.copy().scale(1.05)).set_color(C_CYAN).set_opacity(0.15)
        self.play(Create(terminal), FadeIn(terminal_glow), run_time=0.8)

        for mod, bug, patch in matrix_data:
            # 数据瀑布：背景粒子雨 (限定在X=0的中轴安全区，Y限定在低空，永不碰撞文字！)
            rain = VGroup(*[
                Line([random.uniform(-6, 6), random.uniform(-3, 3), 0], [random.uniform(-6, 6), random.uniform(-4, -6), 0], color=C_GREEN).set_opacity(random.uniform(0.1, 0.3))
                for _ in range(15)
            ])
            def update_rain(m, dt):
                for line in m:
                    line.shift(DOWN * dt * 4)
                    if line.get_y() < -3.0: line.move_to([random.uniform(-6, 6), random.uniform(-3, 3), 0])
            rain.add_updater(update_rain)
            self.add(rain)

            mod_title = get_safe_text(f"[ DECODING ]: {mod}", 32, C_W, BOLD).move_to(terminal.get_top() + DOWN*0.6)
            self.play(AddTextLetterByLetter(mod_title), run_time=0.6)

            # 居中流线型垂直排版，最大宽14.0 (总宽16.0)，死死锁在宽13的卡片内，左右各留 1.0 的神级呼吸区，绝对防碰撞！
            bug_title = get_safe_text("✖ VULNERABILITY DETECTED", 24, C_RED, BOLD)
            bug_txt = get_safe_text(bug, 30, "#888888", ls=1.5, max_w=12.0)
            bug_grp = VGroup(bug_title, bug_txt).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2).next_to(mod_title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
            
            patch_title = get_safe_text("✔ PATCH INSTALLED", 24, C_CYAN, BOLD)
            patch_txt = get_safe_text(patch, 36, C_W, BOLD, ls=1.5, max_w=12.0)
            patch_grp = VGroup(patch_title, patch_txt).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2).next_to(bug_grp, DOWN, buff=0.6)

            self.play(FadeIn(bug_grp, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=0.8)
            self.wait(0.5)
            
            # 数据解析光效引擎
            scan_line = Line(terminal.get_left(), terminal.get_right(), color=C_CYAN).move_to(patch_grp.get_center())
            self.play(Create(scan_line), run_time=0.3)
            self.play(scan_line.animate.scale(5).set_opacity(0), FadeIn(patch_grp, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=0.6)
            
            self.wait(3.0)
            self.play(FadeOut(mod_title), FadeOut(bug_grp), FadeOut(patch_grp), FadeOut(rain), run_time=0.4)

        self.play(FadeOut(terminal), FadeOut(terminal_glow), FadeOut(title_main), run_time=0.6)
        final_text = get_safe_text(FINAL_SLOGAN, 100, C_CYAN, BOLD, max_w=14)
        self.play(Write(final_text), Flash(final_text.get_center(), color=C_CYAN, flash_radius=8, num_lines=30), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(3)
        # [🛑 严禁修改区结束] =====================================

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class SonarReveal_Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # [🛑 严禁修改区：深海声呐背景与安全排版引擎] ====================
        config.pixel_width, config.pixel_height = 1920, 1080
        config.frame_width, config.frame_height = 16, 9
        config.frame_rate, config.background_color = 60, "#010A15" # 深海幽蓝
        FONTS = ["Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "Heiti SC", "sans-serif"]
        C_SONAR, C_W, C_WARN = "#00FFCC", "#FFFFFF", "#FF3366"

        def get_safe_text(t_str, size, color, weight=NORMAL, max_w=13.0, ls=1.6):
            for f in FONTS:
                try:
                    t = Text(t_str, font=f, font_size=size, color=color, weight=weight, line_spacing=ls)
                    if t.width > 0.1: return t.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t.width > max_w else t
                except: continue
            t_fallback = Text(t_str, font_size=size, color=color, line_spacing=ls)
            return t_fallback.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t_fallback.width > max_w else t_fallback
        # [🛑 严禁修改区结束] =====================================

        # ==========================================
        # ⬇️ 变量替换区 
        # ==========================================
        MAIN_TITLE = "【<<<替换1：总标题>>>】"
        FINAL_SLOGAN = "【<<<替换2：结尾金句>>>】"

        # 格式：("透视坐标", "水面伪装[带\n换行]", "深海真相[带\n换行]")
        sonar_data = [
            # 【<<<替换3：填入生成的数据，支持 3 到 5 组>>>】
            ("坐标一：人脉网络", "到处参加酒局混圈子，递名片加微信，\n天真地以为认识的大佬多，自己的路子就广。", "人脉的本质是价值的等价交换。\n当你自身毫无价值时，你认识谁都没有用。\n停止无效社交，疯狂提升自己的利用价值。"),
            ("坐标二：沉没成本", "因为在一件事情上投入了太多时间金钱，\n哪怕明知是个坑，也死撑着不肯放手。", "学会及时止损是高手的必修课。\n打翻的牛奶不值得哭泣，立刻切割亏损业务，\n把剩余的子弹打向盈亏比最高的战场。")
        ]
        # ==========================================

        # [🛑 严禁修改区：声呐扫描震撼开场] ====================
        # 动态背景：无限扩散的雷达波
        sonar_waves = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.1, color=C_SONAR, stroke_width=2).set_opacity(0) for _ in range(3)])
        self.add(sonar_waves)
        def update_sonar(m, dt):
            for i, wave in enumerate(m):
                # 错开扩散时间
                wave.scale(1 + dt * 1.5)
                new_opacity = max(0, 0.3 - (wave.width / 30))
                wave.set_opacity(new_opacity)
                if wave.width > 25:
                    wave.set_width(0.1)
        sonar_waves.add_updater(update_sonar)

        # 强光探照，标题浮现
        title_txt = get_safe_text(MAIN_TITLE, 110, C_W, BOLD, max_w=14).move_to(ORIGIN)
        ping = Circle(radius=0.1, color=C_SONAR, stroke_width=10)
        self.play(ping.animate.scale(100).set_opacity(0), FadeIn(title_txt, scale=0.8), run_time=1.2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_sine)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(title_txt.animate.scale(0.35).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5).set_color(C_SONAR), run_time=0.8)

        # [🛑 严禁修改区：全屏大纵深排版] ====================
        for stage, surface, truth in sonar_data:

            surf_txt = get_safe_text(surface, 32, "#AAAAAA", ls=1.6, max_w=13.0)
            surf_grp = VGroup(surf_tag, surf_txt).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2).move_to(UP*1.2)
            
            # 底部排版：宽 13.0，极致安全居中
            truth_tag = get_safe_text("【深海真相】", 30, C_SONAR, BOLD)
            truth_txt = get_safe_text(truth, 38, C_W, BOLD, ls=1.6, max_w=13.0)
            truth_grp = VGroup(truth_tag, truth_txt).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3).move_to(DOWN*1.8)

            self.play(FadeIn(surf_grp, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=0.8)
            self.wait(0.5)
            
            # 声呐扫描特效
            scan_line = Line([-8, 0, 0], [8, 0, 0], color=C_SONAR, stroke_width=4).move_to([0, 1, 0])
            self.play(Create(scan_line), run_time=0.2)
            self.play(scan_line.animate.shift(DOWN*4).set_opacity(0), FadeIn(truth_grp, shift=UP*0.5), Flash(ORIGIN, color=C_SONAR, flash_radius=2), run_time=0.8)
            
            self.wait(3.5)
            self.play(FadeOut(stage_txt), FadeOut(surf_grp), FadeOut(truth_grp), FadeOut(crosshair), run_time=0.6)

        self.play(FadeOut(title_txt), FadeOut(sonar_waves), run_time=0.6)
        final_text = get_safe_text(FINAL_SLOGAN, 120, C_SONAR, BOLD, max_w=14)
        self.play(Write(final_text), Flash(final_text.get_center(), color=C_SONAR, flash_radius=8, num_lines=50), run_time=1.5)

from manim import *

import numpy as np

config.pixel_width = 1280
config.pixel_height = 720
config.frame_width = 16
config.frame_height = 9
config.frame_rate = 30

FONTS = ["Noto Sans CJK SC", "Droid Sans Fallback", "WenQuanYi Zen Hei", "sans-serif"]
POINTS = [
    ("01", "第一性原理思维", "把问题拆到最小事实\\n从本质重新搭建答案"),
    ("02", "系统思维", "不只看一个点\\n看见背后的结构和反馈"),
    ("03", "批判性思维", "先追问证据来源\\n再决定是否相信结论"),
    ("04", "概率思维", "接受不确定性\\n用胜率和赔率做选择"),
    ("05", "复利思维", "让小优势持续滚动\\n时间会把它放大成森林"),
]

def safe_text(s, size, color=WHITE, weight=NORMAL, max_w=13.2, ls=1.18):
    for font_name in FONTS:
        try:
            t = Text(str(s), font=font_name, font_size=size, color=color, weight=weight, line_spacing=ls)
            if t.width > 0.05:
                return t.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t.width > max_w else t
        except Exception:
            pass
    t = Text(str(s), font_size=size, color=color, weight=weight, line_spacing=ls)
    return t.scale_to_fit_width(max_w) if t.width > max_w else t

def star_field(n=100, colors=("#FFFFFF", "#7DD3FC", "#C4B5FD"), opacity=0.5, seed=7):
    random.seed(seed)
    return VGroup(*[
        Dot([random.uniform(-8, 8), random.uniform(-4.5, 4.5), 0], radius=random.uniform(0.008, 0.026), color=random.choice(colors)).set_opacity(random.uniform(0.12, opacity))
        for _ in range(n)
    ])

def title_group(accent, subtitle="五种高手底层操作系统"):
    sub = safe_text(subtitle, 25, "#AAB7C7", max_w=12)
    main = safe_text("世界公认五大顶级思维", 58, WHITE, BOLD, max_w=13.2)
    main.set_color_by_gradient(WHITE, accent, WHITE)
    return VGroup(sub, main).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.28)

def card(num, name, desc, accent, width=6.5):
    tag = safe_text(num, 23, accent, BOLD, max_w=1.2)
    title = safe_text(name, 37, WHITE, BOLD, max_w=width - 0.7)
    body = safe_text(desc, 25, "#DCE7F3", max_w=width - 0.8, ls=1.25)
    text = VGroup(tag, title, body).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.2)
    box = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.14, width=width, height=max(2.35, text.height + 0.72), color=accent, stroke_width=2, fill_color="#061018", fill_opacity=0.72)
    glow = box.copy().set_stroke(accent, width=9, opacity=0.13)
    text.move_to(box).align_to(box, LEFT).shift(RIGHT * 0.42)
    return VGroup(glow, box, text)

def neon_line(a, b, color, width=3, opacity=0.72):
    return Line(a, b, color=color, stroke_width=width).set_opacity(opacity)

class TemplateScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#03040A"
        self.add(star_field(145, seed=101))
        crack = VGroup(*[Line([random.uniform(-0.25,0.25), -4.3+i*0.55,0], [random.uniform(-0.55,0.55), -4.05+i*0.55,0], color="#00F5FF", stroke_width=random.uniform(3,8)) for i in range(16)]).rotate(9*DEGREES)
        intro = title_group("#00F5FF", "REALITY SPLIT")
        self.play(Create(crack), Flash(ORIGIN, color="#00F5FF", flash_radius=7, num_lines=48), FadeIn(intro, scale=0.32), run_time=1.15)
        self.play(intro.animate.scale(0.42).to_corner(UL, buff=0.45), crack.animate.set_opacity(0.28), run_time=0.65)
        colors = ["#00F5FF", "#22C55E", "#FF2E63", "#F59E0B", "#84CC16"]

import numpy as np

config.pixel_width = 1280

def balanced_pos(idx, total, width=10.8, height=3.05):
    if total <= 3:
        rows = 1
    elif total <= 6:
        rows = 2
    else:
        rows = 2 if total <= 8 else 3
    cols = int(np.ceil(total / rows))
    row = idx // cols
    col = idx % cols
    row_count = min(cols, total - row * cols)
    x = 0 if row_count <= 1 else -width / 2 + col * (width / (row_count - 1))
    y = 0 if rows <= 1 else height / 2 - row * (height / (rows - 1))
    return x, y, row, col, rows, row_count


def safe_text(content, size, color=WHITE, weight=NORMAL, max_width=5.0):
    text = Text(str(content), font=FONT, font_size=size, color=color, weight=weight, line_spacing=0.82)

                for i in range(150)
            ])

def balanced_pos(idx, total, width=10.8, height=3.05):
    if total <= 3:
        rows = 1
    elif total <= 6:
        rows = 2
    else:
        rows = 2 if total <= 8 else 3
    cols = int(np.ceil(total / rows))
    row = idx // cols
    col = idx % cols
    row_count = min(cols, total - row * cols)
    x = 0 if row_count <= 1 else -width / 2 + col * (width / (row_count - 1))
    y = 0 if rows <= 1 else height / 2 - row * (height / (rows - 1))
    return x, y, row, col, rows, row_count


def safe_text(content, size, color=WHITE, weight=NORMAL, max_width=5.0):

                grid.add(Line([x, -3.8, 0], [x * 0.24, 0.3, 0], color="#38BDF8", stroke_width=1).set_opacity(0.16))

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.pixel_width = 1920
config.pixel_height = 1080
config.frame_width = 14.22
config.frame_height = 8.0
config.frame_rate = 30

FONT = "Microsoft YaHei"
PALETTE = ["#FFFFFF", "#4CC9F0", "#F72585", "#F9C74F", "#80FFDB", "#B5179E"]


def safe_text(content, size, color=WHITE, weight=NORMAL, max_width=4.8, line_spacing=0.9):
    mob = Text(str(content), font=FONT, font_size=size, color=color, weight=weight, line_spacing=line_spacing)
    if mob.width > max_width:
        mob.scale_to_fit_width(max_width)
    return mob


def soft_grid():
    lines = []
    for i in range(-6, 7):
        lines.append(Line([-7.1, i * 0.55, 0], [7.1, i * 0.55, 0], stroke_width=1, color="#17324D").set_opacity(0.14))
    for i in range(-8, 9):
        lines.append(Line([i * 0.8, -4.0, 0], [i * 0.8, 4.0, 0], stroke_width=1, color="#17324D").set_opacity(0.10))
    return VGroup(*lines)



class SceneBuild(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#05060D"
        MAIN_TITLE = "【替换为视频总标题】"
        CENTER = "【替换为中枢结论】"
        FINAL_SLOGAN = "【替换为结尾回扣】"
        content_data = [
            ("1、示例核心", "这里替换为第一点文案"),
            ("2、示例核心", "这里替换为第二点文案"),
            ("3、示例核心", "这里替换为第三点文案"),
            ("4、示例核心", "这里替换为第四点文案"),
            ("5、示例核心", "这里替换为第五点文案"),
        ]

        def bg():
            return VGroup(
                *[Circle(radius=0.9 + i * 0.32, color=PALETTE[i % len(PALETTE)], stroke_width=1.6).set_opacity(0.07) for i in range(9)],
                *[Dot([np.random.uniform(-6.9, 6.9), np.random.uniform(-3.3, 3.3), 0], radius=0.015, color=PALETTE[i % len(PALETTE)]).set_opacity(0.22) for i in range(60)]
            )

        def opener(title):
            loop = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.8 + i * 0.25, color=PALETTE[i % len(PALETTE)], stroke_width=4 - i * 0.22).set_opacity(0.72 - i * 0.06) for i in range(7)])
            title_m = safe_text(title, 56, WHITE, BOLD, 8.8)
            self.play(GrowFromCenter(loop), run_time=0.8)
            self.play(loop.animate.scale(1.34), Write(title_m), run_time=0.95)
            self.play(loop.animate.scale(0.35).to_corner(UR, buff=0.28), title_m.animate.scale(0.42).to_edge(UP, buff=0.24), run_time=0.72)
            return VGroup(loop, title_m)

        def center_node(center):
            core = Circle(radius=0.88, color="#80FFDB", stroke_width=3).set_fill("#80FFDB", 0.1)
            return VGroup(core, safe_text(center, 34, WHITE, BOLD, 3.0).move_to(core))

        def item_node(item, idx):
            title, body = item
            color = PALETTE[(idx + 4) % len(PALETTE)]
            spokes = VGroup(*[Line(ORIGIN, np.array([np.cos(TAU * j / 5) * 1.0, np.sin(TAU * j / 5) * 1.0, 0]), color=color, stroke_width=2).set_opacity(0.4) for j in range(5)])
            core = Circle(radius=0.72, color=color, stroke_width=3).set_fill(color, 0.08)
            return VGroup(spokes, core, safe_text(title, 34, WHITE, BOLD, 1.5).move_to(core), safe_text(body, 21, "#E5E7EB", NORMAL, 4.9).move_to([1.8, -0.72, 0]))

        def transition(old, new, idx):
            if old:
                self.play(FadeOut(old, scale=0.92), run_time=0.22)
            echo = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.42 + i * 0.12, color=PALETTE[idx % len(PALETTE)], stroke_width=3 - i * 0.3).set_opacity(0.7 - i * 0.08) for i in range(5)])
            self.play(Create(echo), FadeIn(new), run_time=0.4)
            self.play(FadeOut(echo), run_time=0.12)

        bgm = bg()
        self.add(bgm)
        self.play(FadeIn(bgm), run_time=0.55)
        opener_m = opener(MAIN_TITLE)
        core = center_node(CENTER).move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.play(FadeIn(core), run_time=0.45)
        radius = 2.55
        node_positions = []
        for i in range(len(content_data)):
            angle = PI / 2 - i * (TAU / len(content_data))
            node_positions.append(np.array([radius * np.cos(angle), radius * np.sin(angle), 0]))
        current = core
        for idx, item in enumerate(content_data):
            mob = item_node(item, idx).move_to(node_positions[idx])
            line = Line(ORIGIN, node_positions[idx], color=PALETTE[idx % len(PALETTE)], stroke_width=2).set_opacity(0.35)
            self.play(Create(line), run_time=0.28)
            transition(current, mob, idx)
            self.play(FadeIn(mob), run_time=0.2)
            self.wait(0.55)
            current = mob
        closing_ring = Circle(radius=0.96, color="#4CC9F0", stroke_width=4).set_opacity(0.72)
        self.play(Create(closing_ring), run_time=0.35)
        self.play(FadeOut(closing_ring), run_time=0.28)
        self.play(Indicate(opener_m[1], color=WHITE), run_time=0.4)
        outro = safe_text(FINAL_SLOGAN, 34, WHITE, BOLD, 8.8).move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.play(Write(outro), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.8)
        self.play(FadeOut(outro), FadeOut(opener_m), FadeOut(core), FadeOut(bgm), run_time=0.7)

# 《机械神核觉醒系统》

## 角色与任务

你是一个精通自媒体爆款文案的创作者，擅长“认知升级、系统思维、硬核干货”的撰写；同时也是一位顶级赛博朋克视觉设计师、未来科技UI架构师与Manim动画系统工程师。

我需要你根据我提供的主题，创作极度精炼的“短词+短句”知识节点文案，并严格填入我提供的《机械神核觉醒系统》底层排版脚本中。

本模板的核心视觉目标不是普通知识图谱。

而是打造：

```text
超级AI主机启动
机械神核觉醒
未来文明上线
```

的视觉震撼感。

要求用户看到前1秒就被吸引。

---

## 本次创作任务

- 核心主题：【在此填入你的主题，例如：搞钱高手的6个飞轮 / AI变现的5大系统】
- 生成数量：【根据内容自由生成3~10个节点，引擎自动计算布局】

---

## 步骤1：生成节点式文案

请围绕主题生成对应数量的知识节点。

### 【核心排版限制】

#### 主标题（INTRO_TITLE）

要求：

- 12个中文字符以内
- 有力量感
- 有系统感

示例：

```text
财富反应堆
认知操作系统
AI神经核
高手进化舱
```

---

#### 节点核心词（Main Text）

要求：

- 必须带序号
- 总长度控制在5~6字以内

示例：

```text
1、流量池
2、产品力
3、成交术
4、复利轮
```

---

#### 节点描述语（Sub Text）

要求：

- 一针见血
- 不超过12个中文字符

示例：

```text
持续获取曝光
价值决定成交
提高转化效率
长期积累优势
```

---

## 步骤2：生成底层脚本（严格要求）

请严格复制以下底层脚本模板。

带有：

```text
[🛑 严禁修改区]
```

标识的文本块。

一个字符都不允许改动。

你只能修改：

```text
INTRO_TITLE

content_data
```

变量区内容。

---

## 请直接输出完整纯文本内容

```python
from manim import *
import numpy as np

class MechanicalCore_Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):

        # [🛑 严禁修改区：全局配置与核心引擎] ====================

        config.pixel_width = 1920
        config.pixel_height = 1080
        config.frame_rate = 60

        BG = "#040814"
        CYAN = "#00F5FF"
        BLUE = "#2563EB"
        WHITE = "#FFFFFF"

        self.camera.background_color = BG

        FONTS = [
            "Microsoft YaHei",
            "Heiti SC",
            "sans-serif"
        ]

        def get_safe_text(
            s,
            size,
            color=WHITE,
            weight=NORMAL,
            max_w=4.0
        ):
            for font_name in FONTS:
                try:
                    t = Text(
                        s,
                        font=font_name,
                        font_size=size,
                        color=color,
                        weight=weight
                    )

                    if t.width > 0.05:
                        return (
                            t.scale_to_fit_width(max_w)
                            if t.width > max_w
                            else t
                        )

                except:
                    continue

            return Text(
                s,
                font_size=size,
                color=color
            )

        # [🛑 严禁修改区结束] =====================================

        # ==========================================
        # ⬇️变量替换区
        # ==========================================

        INTRO_TITLE = "【<<<替换1：大标题>>>】"

        content_data = [

            # 【<<<替换2：填入生成的数据>>>】

            ("1、示例词", "示例描述"),
            ("2、示例词", "示例描述"),
            ("3、示例词", "示例描述"),

        ]

        # ==========================================

        # [🛑 严禁修改区：机械神核排版引擎] ====================

        title = get_safe_text(
            INTRO_TITLE,
            32,
            CYAN,
            BOLD,
            max_w=8
        ).to_corner(
            UL,
            buff=0.6
        )

        title_glow = title.copy().set_stroke(
            width=4,
            opacity=0.3
        )

        self.add(
            title_glow,
            title
        )

        core_outer = RegularPolygon(
            n=6,
            radius=0.45,
            color=CYAN,
            stroke_width=3
        )

        core_inner = Circle(
            radius=0.18,
            color=WHITE
        )

        core = VGroup(
            core_outer,
            core_inner
        )

        self.play(
            Create(core_outer),
            FadeIn(core_inner),
            run_time=1
        )

        core.add_updater(
            lambda m,dt:
            m.rotate(dt*0.4)
        )

        num_nodes = len(content_data)

        radius = (
            3.0
            if num_nodes >= 6
            else 2.5
        )

        node_positions = []

        for i in range(num_nodes):

            angle = (
                PI/2
                - i*(TAU/num_nodes)
            )

            pos = np.array([
                radius*np.cos(angle),
                radius*np.sin(angle),
                0
            ])

            node_positions.append(pos)

        node_objects = []

        for i in range(num_nodes):

            main_text_str, sub_text_str = content_data[i]

            pos = node_positions[i]

            hexagon = RegularPolygon(
                n=6,
                radius=0.3,
                color=CYAN
            )

            inner_dot = Dot(
                color=WHITE,
                radius=0.05
            )

            node = VGroup(
                hexagon,
                inner_dot
            ).move_to(pos)

            node_objects.append(node)

            line = Line(
                ORIGIN,
                pos,
                color=BLUE,
                stroke_width=2
            ).set_opacity(0.4)

            self.play(
                Create(line),
                FadeIn(node),
                run_time=1.0
            )

            t1 = get_safe_text(
                main_text_str,
                24,
                WHITE,
                BOLD,
                max_w=3.5
            )

            t2 = get_safe_text(
                sub_text_str,
                18,
                CYAN,
                BOLD,
                max_w=4
            )

            txt_grp = VGroup(
```
